name: Pattern Sampler
description: A grid of small skewed tile motifs in a mixed duotone ink palette, each cell its own miniature study.

code.style: --rule: ( background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); opacity: .85; transform: scale(.5) translate(-50%, -50%); margin: 3%; box-shadow: 10% 10% 0 18% @pd(var(--color5), var(--color6), var(--color7), var(--color8)); :after, :before { content: ''; position: absolute; @size: 100%; transform-origin: 0 0; } :after { background: @p(var(--color5), var(--color6), var(--color7), var(--color8)); transform: translateX(100%) skewY(45deg); } :before { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); transform: translateY(100%) skewX(45deg); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
